messages.author: eb9a4188a4906706
messages.subject: Error in prt(tr, printflag = FALSE)
parts:
Dear Nick, I am having some trouble with BGBs. I am trying to run a DEC-J time stratified analysis, however  when I check my BGBs configuration I  get the following error:

Error in prt(tr, printflag = FALSE) : object 'tr' not found
Called from: prt(tr, printflag = FALSE)

Actually I ran this same dataset on February  and I did not get any errors, but now I am doing the same analysis  with a slightly different tree and I am having this issue. Currently I am using the new source files. Also when running a non-stratified analysis with the same dataset everything runs perfect.

Any advice?

All the best.

Fix is uploaded to BioGeoBEARS_classes_v1.R, let me know if you have issues.

Cheers!
Nick
